description.Name: Characterisation of laminar and vascular spatiotemporal dynamics of CBV and BOLD signals using VASO and ME-GRE at 7T in humans

latestSnapshot.readme:
This dataset refers to the layer-fMRI study in which we combined sub-millimetre functional SS-SI VASO and anatomical ME-GRE data acquired at 0.9mm and 0.35mm isotropic resolution, respectively, to investigate laminar and vascular CBV and BOLD responses.

A preprint will be available soon.
